title: Schreibzeit (No Text to Copy)
summary: A screen-filling construction of ascending numbers that, as document text, is zero characters long.
mechanism: CSS counter-increment / counter() generated content: the digits live only in the ::before render layer, absent from the DOM text and dropped on copy; a tiny JS line attests textContent.length === 0.
references: Hanne Darboven, the date-sum Konstruktionen / Ein Jahrhundert
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
